nodes.name: Thermal exfoliation of Ho-GO with guano
nodes.procedure: Guano-decorated Ho-GO (Ho-GO-BD) was prepared via thermal exfoliation with Ho-GO graphite oxide precursor in the presence of guano (bird droppings).
